spec: Build a product-feedback service. Customers submit feedback with a rating from 1 to 5 and a comment. Feedback is stored in DynamoDB, and any submission with a rating of 1 or 2 triggers a notification to an SNS topic so support staff are alerted. Include endpoints to list feedback and to show the average rating.

complexity.rationale: Conditional low-rating notification and average calculation span storage and messaging.

plan.summary: A FastAPI JSON service that accepts customer product feedback (rating 1-5 plus comment), persists each submission to a DynamoDB table, and publishes an alert to an SNS topic whenever a submission has a low rating (1 or 2). It also exposes endpoints to list stored feedback (optionally filtered by product) and to compute the average rating across feedback.

endpoints.purpose: Submit new feedback (product_id, rating 1-5, comment, optional customer_email); writes an item to DynamoDB and publishes an SNS alert when rating <= 2.
List stored feedback with optional product_id and rating filters plus a limit, returning items from DynamoDB.
Retrieve a single feedback record by its identifier.
Return the average rating (and count / per-rating breakdown), optionally scoped to a single product_id.
Liveness/readiness probe used by the evaluation harness.

data_models.name: Feedback
fields: alert_sent: bool (true when an SNS low-rating alert was published)

aws_resources.name: product-feedback
aws_resources.justification: Primary store for feedback submissions; the app writes items on POST /feedback and reads them for GET /feedback, GET /feedback/{id} and the average-rating calculation. Partition key feedback_id (S) with a product_id-created_at global secondary index to support per-product listing and stats without full scans.

aws_resources.name: product-feedback-low-rating-alerts
aws_resources.justification: The spec requires support staff to be notified when a submission has a rating of 1 or 2; the app publishes a JSON alert message to this topic directly from the POST /feedback handler.

aws_resources.name: product-feedback-service-role
aws_resources.justification: Execution role/policy granting the backend service least-privilege access: dynamodb:PutItem/GetItem/Query/Scan on the feedback table and its GSI, and sns:Publish on the alert topic.

aws_resources.name: /cloudforge/product-feedback-service
aws_resources.justification: Log group for application logs (submissions, alert publishes, errors) so operators can trace low-rating notifications.

assumptions: No authentication is specified, so all endpoints are open; identity is captured only via the optional customer_email field.
Feedback is per-product, so a product_id field is included on submissions; if a caller omits it the request is rejected as invalid (400/422).
'Low rating' means rating <= 2 (i.e. 1 or 2), evaluated at write time only; no re-evaluation on updates since feedback is immutable.
Feedback records are immutable — no update or delete endpoints were requested, so none are planned.
The SNS topic has no subscriptions provisioned by this stack; support staff subscribe out-of-band (LocalStack Community supports the topic and publish calls).
The average rating is computed in application code over the DynamoDB items (scan or GSI query) rather than in a precomputed aggregate, which is adequate for the expected data volume.

No queue worker, scheduled job, or event-driven processing is required, so Lambda and API Gateway are deliberately not planned; the FastAPI service runs standalone and calls DynamoDB and SNS directly.
No secrets beyond AWS credentials are needed, so Secrets Manager is not planned.
Endpoint region and resource names come from environment variables (AWS_REGION, FEEDBACK_TABLE, LOW_RATING_TOPIC_ARN, AWS_ENDPOINT_URL) so the app can target LocalStack.
